objects.taxonomy_description: Fabric bag with two parallel shoulder straps for carrying on the back. The main compartment is a rectangular or rounded pouch (30-55 cm tall) made of nylon, canvas, or polyester with a zipper or drawstring closure. objects.taxonomy_description: Asian proboscidean measuring 250-300 cm at shoulder weighing 3000-5000 kg. Body massive with thick wrinkled gray-brown skin and sparse body hair. Head broad with twin-domed skull. Ears relatively small compared to African elephant. Trunk (proboscis) elongated and muscular with single finger-like projection at tip. Tusks present primarily in males, shorter than African species. Body barrel-shaped with arched back. Legs pillar-like with five toenails on forefeet. Tail long with terminal tuft. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart.

objects.taxonomy_description: Bowed stringed instrument with a curved wooden body approximately 35 cm long. Body has an hourglass shape with C-bouts (inward curves) on each side. Top plate (soundboard) is spruce with two f-shaped sound holes. Back plate is maple with a distinctive flame pattern. Four strings (G, D, A, E) run from a tailpiece at the base over a bridge to tuning pegs in the scroll. Neck extends from the body to a carved scroll at the top. Fingerboard is ebony (black). Varnish finish is amber, reddish-brown, or golden. Chin rest is attached at the lower left. Bow is a wooden stick with horsehair.
